items.title: 12.12 Role of sulfur in the organic synthesis of drugs, dyes and fragrances (dawaiyon, rangon aur khushbuon ki tayyari mein sulfur ka role) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 12.12, printed page 283.

blocks.text: Carbon-sulfur bonds bohat se aise compounds mein paye jate hain jo biology, pharmaceuticals (dawaiyon) aur materials mein kaam aate hain. In bonds se different (alag alag) functional groups wale bohat se organic compounds bante hain, jaise thiols ya mercaptans, thioethers, sulfoxides aur sulfones.

blocks.prompt: Disulfide bridges (pul) ki kya importance (ahmiyat) hai (exercise Q.2m)?
blocks.explanation: Do thiol (–SH) groups oxidise ho kar S–S (disulfide) bridges banate hain. Proteins mein yeh bridges cysteine units ko jor kar protein ki muri hui shakal ko qaim rakhte hain, bilkul jaise vulcanised rubber mein S–S bridges. Enzymes, antibodies aur baalon ka keratin isi se mazboot hote hain.

items: C–S bonds: thiols (R–SH), thioethers, sulfoxides, sulfones; drugs, dyes aur fragrances mein.
